body:
Working entry (chk-4wn3jy7s, Epoch 4 — Determinism and exploration): «Start in a state — a session starts in a given
fixture state, a bounded validated argument, on 0.2.0's shared fixtures (v030-08)». The entry carries no freight block
(`pins` lists none for chk-4wn3jy7s).

Capability: `matrix#v030-08` — requirement «A session can start in a given state, a fixture, building on 0.2.0's shared
fixtures»; observed gap «A check starts from boot and clicks its way to the state it tests»; acceptance (integration)
«A session starts in a named fixture state, and its first screen reads as that state does when reached by hand from
boot». Intent §7 (C4, the founder's «E2 автоисследование + C4 фикстуры», 2026-10-26).

- A driver session can be started in a named fixture state of its app instead of at boot: the app's own table names
  its states, the session's first screen is that state's, and every verb after it acts on it as on any held screen.

- The state is named by a bounded, validated argument: checked by the driver's schema before anything runs, a name the
  app's table does not hold refused with nothing started, no panic path on what the call supplies (CLAUDE.md
  invariant), nothing the caller typed written back.

- The proof: for each named state, the first screen of a session started in it reads (snapshot text, by answer digest
  or whole) as the same app's screen does when that state is reached by hand from boot through the driver's own verbs,
  in both layout modes.

- The stand's served tasks name at least the states a stand check today reaches by clicking from boot, so the observed
  gap is closed where it was observed.

- `[inferred]` The state crosses on the carriers `start` already rides — the command line (`start {task} --state
  {name}`), the MCP `start` tool and the socket's `hello` — as one optional argument of a closed value set per app;
  whether a new argument on a ratified carrier is a boundary widening, and its carrier set, is a fork P4 settles (the
  founder's rule of 2026-10-10 covers a closed-value FIELD on a ratified carrier; an ARGUMENT in is not yet ruled).

- `[inferred]` A kept check (`--record`) of a session started in a state must replay from that state: the check's
  closed key set and `Check::from_bytes` take the state name, or a recorded session started in a state is refused —
  a fork for P4 (a change to the kept check's at-rest content).

- `[inferred]` "0.2.0's shared fixtures" is `tests/blitz-tests/tests/fixtures/mod.rs` (boot, hold, pages and the held
  network stand-in, «the one statement of what the checks beside the stand share»); the chunk builds on its boot and
  hold rather than a second boot path. P3 closes whether the fixture states live in seven_guis (served) or in the test
  fixtures (test-only), or both.

- `[inferred]` How a state is reached — an app-supplied initial state (the way the seed rides a Dioxus root context)
  versus steps run from boot inside `start` — is open; P3 measures what each task's state needs and P4 decides.

- No new socket, port, listener, env read, log field or span field; the command span records no state name (a state
  name is a call-supplied argument — security rules §Surfaces).
- No change to the engine (blitz-dom) is expected.

- Out: auto-exploration (the next entry, v030-09), a seed on the driver's carriers (the founder's open F1 of
  2026-11-14-seeded-randomness), a component alone with props (v030-12).

- `packages/escher-driver/src/schema.rs` (`START`, the verb table, `describe()`), `command.rs`, `cli.rs`, `mcp.rs`,
  `session.rs`, `host.rs`, `wire.rs`, `recording.rs`, `replay.rs`, `coverage.rs` (a check's replay boot).
- `examples/seven_guis/src/{stand.rs,session_host.rs}` — the served tasks and their boot.

_Generated by /andromeda-phase P4. Read by /andromeda-implement. Manual edits between runs are fine; do not
edit during an /implement run._
- **Marker:** 2026-11-14-start-in-a-state · **Version:** escher-0.3.0 · **Generated:** 2026-11-14T12:06:53Z

A driver session can start in a named fixture state of its app instead of at boot, its first screen reading as that
state does when reached by hand from boot (`matrix#v030-08`, intent §7 C4). A fixture state is static data the app
owns — a name and the driver calls that reach it from boot — and the session reaches it by running each call through
`Session::run`, the one validated run path (architecture · decision/validated-commands-only; security-plan ·
decision/one-validation-path-for-every-carrier), on a session already started, so `Session::start` and its 35 call
sites stay as they are (research §Graph impact). The stand names three states, one per pattern its checks reach by
input from boot today: CRUD after twelve Creates (`examples/seven_guis/tests/cli_commands.rs:604`), CRUD with a row
selected and the flight booker with a return flight chosen (`tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:67`,
`ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`). The shared fixtures module (architecture · decision/fixtures-test-module) gains a hold in a
named state beside its `hold`, so a fixture page starts in a state the same way.

How a state crosses the driver's carriers is the founder's fork F1 (`.andromeda/runs/2026-11-14T11-32-16-phase/founder-forks.md`),
a boundary widening under the playbook's `rul-izni57qv`. The founder is away; on the operator's directive (inputs#I1)
the plan builds the most conservative option, C, PROVISIONAL: the state is started in process — the driver library,
the stand and the shared fixtures — and nothing crosses the command line, MCP, the session socket or a kept check's
form. Because the reach runs through `Session::run`, a session recording attached before the reach keeps the steps as
ordinary steps (`packages/escher-driver/src/cli.rs:437-438` attaches after the boot), so its kept check opens on the
app and replays from boot with no change to `Check::from_bytes`. No span, log site, print or env read is added; no
step of the reach is logged beyond the `command` span every `Session::run` call already opens (obs-plan ·
decision/driver-spans-carry-no-content).

1. **The fixture state in the driver** — create `packages/escher-driver/src/fixture.rs`:
   - a public `FixtureStep` enum of the four acting calls a state is reached by — `Click(id)`, `Type(id, text)`,
     `Press(key)`, `Advance(ms)` — each over `&'static str` / `u32`, mirroring the stand checks' `Drive`
     (`tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:245`);
   - a public `Fixture` struct holding a `&'static str` name and a `&'static [FixtureStep]`, built by a `const fn new`,
     with a reader for its name; and a crate-private conversion of a step to the `Call` the verb table spells (the
     verb's name and its arguments by their schema names, in schema order — `id`, `text`, `key`, `ms`);
   - a public `ReachError` enum, `Display` and `Debug`, holding nothing a caller supplied: `UnknownState` (a name no
     fixture of the table carries, compared whole and byte for byte — the table is the closed set, so a name of any
     other form, empty, longer than 32 bytes, upper-case or holding `/`, reads `UnknownState` by that comparison
     alone), `Refused { step, cause }` (the step's index and its refusal's closed `Cause`) and `NotSettled { step, busy }`
     (an accepted acting step whose outcome reads `settled: false`, with its `Busy` class);
   - a public lookup `Fixture::named(fixtures: &'static [Fixture], name: &str) -> Result<&'static Fixture, ReachError>`;
     every name in a table is 1 to 32 bytes of `a-z`, `0-9` and `-`, the session label's form (`valid_label`,
     `packages/escher-driver/src/session.rs:55`), asserted by the unit tests over the stand's table rather than at run
     time;
   - `Session::reach(&mut self, fixture: &Fixture) -> Result<(), ReachError>` (an `impl Session` block in this file):
     runs each step's call through `Session::run` in order and stops at the first refused or unsettled step, the
     steps before it standing (not rolled back, as an acting call is not). No span, log site or print of its own.
   Keeps arch S4 (module and item docs, `pub(crate)` internals, a typed error enum, no `unwrap`/`expect` outside
   tests) and S5.

2. **Its unit tests** — create `packages/escher-driver/src/fixture_tests.rs`, declared `#[cfg(test)] #[path]` at the
   end of `fixture.rs` (arch S5): each step converts to the call `validate` admits, the verb's arguments in schema
   order (a table stated in the test, its row count asserted — tests S8, decision/table-tests-count-their-rows);
   `Fixture::named` returns the named fixture, and `UnknownState` for an absent name, the empty name, a 33-byte name,
   an upper-case name and a name holding `/` or `.`; every name of a table the tests state is in the label's form;
   `ReachError`'s `Display` texts are fixed, holding none of the
   names tried. Failure messages name a row and an index only.

3. **Exports** — in `packages/escher-driver/src/lib.rs` declare `mod fixture;` beside the others
   (`packages/escher-driver/src/lib.rs:141-160`) and re-export `Fixture`, `FixtureStep` and `ReachError`; add one
   paragraph to the crate doc naming a session started in a named fixture state, in process.

4. **The stand's three states** — in `examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs` add, on native only as the session boot is:
   - one table of the stand's fixture states per lean task, stated once: CRUD's `fourteen-people` (twelve
     `Click("crud-create")`), CRUD's `person-selected` (`Click("crud-person-0")`) and the flight booker's
     `return-flight` (`Type("flight-type", "r")`), each reaching exactly what the stand check named in the Goal reaches;
     a reader `fixtures(task: LeanTask) -> &'static [Fixture]` (the Counter and the Timer hold none);
   - `start_in(label, task, name, incremental) -> Result<Session, StartInError>` or the equivalent pair the driver's
     types allow: `Session::start(label, || boot(task, options(incremental)))`, then `Fixture::named` over the task's
     table, then `Session::reach` — a refused label returns its `SessionError`, a refused name or step its
     `ReachError`, through one small enum of the two (or `Result<Result<…>>`, whichever reads plainer), nothing
     panicking. No markup, id, class, style or wrapper is added to any task (layouts ·
     decision/session-roles-share-stand-boot).

5. **The shared fixtures' hold in a state** — in `tests/blitz-tests/tests/fixtures/mod.rs` add `hold_in(label, app,
   fixture, incremental) -> Session` beside `hold`: `hold` then `Session::reach`, an `expect` with its written
   justification (a fixture the module's reader names must reach, else the check is wrong) — the module holding no
   print, tracing, env read, file, socket or listener as before (test-plan · decision/shared-fixtures-in-one-module).

6. **The proof** — create `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_start_in_state.rs`, its `//!` naming the behaviour, every
   test in both layout modes, the fixture's condition asserted first, failure messages naming a layout mode, a task
   or page and an index only (keeps arch S1-S2, tests S1-S2 and S8, obs S1 and S3, a11y S3, design S1, layouts S1):
   - `every_named_state_reads_as_its_by_hand_path_from_boot` — for each of the stand's three states: a session
     started in it by `stand::start_in`, and a session of the same task started at boot and driven by the check's OWN
     by-hand table of calls (written in the check, not read from the stand's table, so the two paths are stated
     apart); first assert the started session's `snapshot` answer differs from a fresh boot's (the state is not
     boot), then assert the two sessions answer `snapshot`, `lint`, `actions` and `graph` with equal answer lines
     (`answer_digest` equal, and the snapshot text equal whole);
   - `a_session_started_in_a_state_takes_the_next_call_as_the_by_hand_one_does` — on CRUD's `fourteen-people`,
     `click` on `crud-person-14` is refused `off-screen` in both sessions, then `scroll` and `click` on it answer
     equal lines in both;
   - `a_name_no_state_holds_is_refused_and_the_session_reads_as_boot` — `Fixture::named` refuses an absent name, the
     empty name, a 33-byte name and an upper-case name `UnknownState`, a Counter (which holds no state) refuses any
     name, and a session the refused name was asked for answers `snapshot` as a fresh boot does;
   - `a_step_the_screen_refuses_stops_the_reach_naming_its_index_and_cause` — a fixture stated in the check whose
     second step clicks CRUD's `crud-delete` (disabled at boot, test-plan's `stand_act_refused` reading) stops with
     `Refused { step: 1, cause: Cause::Disabled }`, the first step's effect standing;
   - `a_fixture_page_held_in_a_state_reads_as_its_clicks_from_boot` — the shared `many_items` page held by
     `fixtures::hold_in` in a fixture stated in the check (three `Click("item-001")`) answers `snapshot` as the same
     page held by `fixtures::hold` and clicked three times by hand;
   - `a_recorded_session_started_in_a_state_replays_from_boot` (`#[cfg(unix)]`, tests S4) — a session started at
     boot with `recording_into` a fresh owner-only directory under `CARGO_TARGET_TMPDIR`, then reaching CRUD's
     `fourteen-people` and answering one `snapshot`: its kept check, read back by `Check::from_bytes`, opens on the
     task's label, holds the reach's twelve steps and the snapshot, and replays holding on a fresh boot of the task
     (`Check::replay(..).holds()`); nothing of the directory is printed, and the directory is removed at the end.
   The check declares `mod fixtures;` and reads the stand's tables from `seven_guis::stand`; it is picked up by the
   blitz-tests target pin (one target per file, `BlitzTestsTargetsTest`) and the `stand-repeat` leg by its prefix, with
   no leg list changed (a11y history, 2026-11-08-handler-coverage's precedent).

7. **The capability statement** — in `docs/capabilities.md`, by hand: under «What it can do» a line naming a session
   started in a named fixture state, in process (the driver's `Fixture` and `Session::reach`, the stand's three
   states), its check `stand_start_in_state` under «Where each claim is proven»; under «Stated limits» that no state
   crosses the command line, MCP, the session socket or a kept check (provisional on the founder's F1). No verb,
   argument, cause, session error, node key or exit count moves, so its pin reads the same.

8. **Remove-the-guard controls** (implement's one-shot `gate.py control` run, never an entry; per the operator's
   directive a control's `case` is the test name alone, inputs#I1):
   - guard 1: in `packages/escher-driver/src/fixture.rs`, the stop at a refused step — remove the early return on a
     refused step's answer so the reach runs on; `case` `a_step_the_screen_refuses_stops_the_reach_naming_its_index_and_cause`;
   - guard 2: in `examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs`, CRUD's `fourteen-people` row — remove one of its twelve
     `Click("crud-create")` steps; `case` `every_named_state_reads_as_its_by_hand_path_from_boot`.
- `packages/escher-driver/src/fixture.rs` — `Fixture`, `FixtureStep`, `ReachError`, `Fixture::named`, `Session::reach`
- `packages/escher-driver/src/fixture_tests.rs` — the fixture module's unit tests
- `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_start_in_state.rs` — the proof, both layout modes
- `packages/escher-driver/src/lib.rs` — `mod fixture;`, three re-exports, one crate-doc paragraph
- `examples/seven_guis/src/stand.rs` — the stand's fixture table per lean task and `start_in`
- `tests/blitz-tests/tests/fixtures/mod.rs` — `hold_in` beside `hold`
- `docs/capabilities.md` — the in-process start in a state, its check, and the carriers' stated limit

The gates below run the driver's unit tests, the new check, seven_guis' tests (its stand module changes), the doc leg
for the new public items, and the local pre-push gate `fast` (fmt → clippy → workspace tests → CI scripts →
embolden). No live leg: the new check is an in-process cargo target. The diff adds an OS-conditional site — the
`#[cfg(unix)]` recording test — so the plan carries the operator's hygiene, push and CI entries; the CI entry's note
names the OS legs that witness it. The `coverage` and `stand-repeat` legs run in CI, read through that entry.

- (driver) A `Fixture` is a name and a static list of driver calls; `Session::reach` runs each through `Session::run`
  and stops at the first refused or unsettled step with `ReachError::Refused { step, cause }` or `NotSettled { step,
  busy }`; `Fixture::named` refuses any name its table does not hold — the empty name, a 33-byte name, an upper-case
  name and a name holding `/` among them — `UnknownState`, holding nothing the caller supplied (security-plan · decision/no-panic-on-call-input,
  decision/refusal-holds-no-call-input) — `cargo test -p escher-driver --locked` and
  `cargo test -p blitz-tests --test stand_start_in_state --locked` return 0.

- (capability) `matrix#v030-08` — in process, in both layout modes, a driver session started in each of the stand's
  three named fixture states (CRUD `fourteen-people`, CRUD `person-selected`, flight booker `return-flight`) answers
  `snapshot`, `lint`, `actions` and `graph` with the same lines as a session of the same task driven by hand from boot
  through the driver's own calls to that state, and takes the next call as that session does; a name the task's table
  does not hold is refused `UnknownState` with nothing run — `every_named_state_reads_as_its_by_hand_path_from_boot`,
  `a_session_started_in_a_state_takes_the_next_call_as_the_by_hand_one_does` and
  `a_name_no_state_holds_is_refused_and_the_session_reads_as_boot` in
  `cargo test -p blitz-tests --test stand_start_in_state --locked`.

- (fixtures) the shared fixtures' `hold_in` holds a fixture page in a named state that reads as the same page clicked
  by hand from boot — `a_fixture_page_held_in_a_state_reads_as_its_clicks_from_boot` (test-plan ·
  decision/shared-fixtures-in-one-module).

- (recording) a recorded session that reaches a state keeps the reach's steps as ordinary steps and its kept check
  replays from boot holding, the check's form unchanged (architecture · contract/kept-check/opening-record) —
  `a_recorded_session_started_in_a_state_replays_from_boot` on linux and macOS.

- (silence) no span field, log site, print or env read is added; `cargo test -p seven_guis --locked` (its `host_log`
  and `mcp_log` reads included) returns 0 (obs-plan · decision/command-span-no-call-content, decision/checks-silent).

- (gates) `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh fast` and `bash .github/scripts/ci-leg.sh doc` return 0; CI on the operator
  pass's final HEAD reads `verdict: green` (the run id recorded).

- Spec anchors: (architecture · decision/validated-commands-only), (architecture · decision/fixtures-test-module),
  (architecture · decision/session-library-depends-on-no-app), (architecture · contract/kept-check/opening-record),
  (architecture · decision/no-seed-on-carriers) as the provisional-absence precedent, (security-plan ·
  decision/one-validation-path-for-every-carrier), (security-plan · decision/boundary-widening-rule), (security-plan ·
  decision/refusal-holds-no-call-input), (test-plan · decision/shared-fixtures-in-one-module), (test-plan ·
  decision/stand-checks-in-both-layout-modes), (obs-plan · decision/driver-spans-carry-no-content), (layouts ·
  decision/session-roles-share-stand-boot), (a11y · decision/click-focuses-buttons).

- Research files inspected: `packages/escher-driver/src/{session,execute,cli,mcp,schema,command,recording,replay,coverage,error}.rs`,
  `packages/escher-driver/src/mcp/listing.rs`, `examples/seven_guis/src/{session_host,stand}.rs`,
  `examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs`, `tests/blitz-tests/tests/{fixtures,common}/mod.rs`,
  `examples/seven_guis/tests/cli_commands.rs`, `scripts/cold-agent.sh`.

- Fork: F1 in `.andromeda/runs/2026-11-14T11-32-16-phase/founder-forks.md`, provisional C on the operator's directive
  (inputs#I1).

- A state threaded through `Session::start`'s signature — rejected: 35 call sites move (research §Graph impact, query 1)
  for nothing a step on a started session does not give.

- An app-supplied initial state (a root context or a signal initializer) — rejected: it cannot give the focus a
  by-hand path leaves (a11y · decision/click-focuses-buttons; a node created in the render that sets it cannot be
  focused, 2026-11-07-mounteddata-buffered-render), and CRUD's `next_id` and `selected` are in-component initializers
  (`examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:14-60`), so the first screens would differ.

  row that no fixture state crosses the driver's carriers, PROVISIONAL on the founder's F1 (beside
  (architecture · decision/no-seed-on-carriers)).

  closed table, any other refused `UnknownState` holding nothing supplied; the absence of a state on the carriers,

  founder, so the wrap's full escalation stands).
